descs.en: The boy next door followed her to university and stayed “unofficial” for years. She loves him. She just doesn’t know how to go from friends to forever.

titles.en: The Boy Next Door Never Left

ideaNote: Planned: 50 chapters. Next Door · Unofficial · The Father · Official · Side stories.

synopsis.title: Synopsis
synopsis.content:
Eliana Lin is the youngest Lin, the one whose birth cost her mother’s life, the one who scrubs her siblings’ digital footprints from three screens at two in the morning. Wang Yu Chen has lived next door all her life. He sat with her on the porch steps when she was afraid of the silence in her own house, followed her to the same university, and has waited ever since, unofficially.

Everyone knows. Their friends know, her sisters know, the cousin who raised him knows. The only person who won’t say it out loud is Eliana, because saying it would make it something she could lose.

authorNote.title: Author Note
authorNote.content:
This is the softest book after The Softest Kind of Love: two people who already love each other learning to say so. Nobody cheats, nobody lies for twenty chapters. It’s nerdy and slow and full of sticky notes.

Their first times are shy and clumsy and real, with a lot of stopping to laugh. He researches everything first; she breaks his plan.

contentWarn.title: Content Warning
contentWarn.content:
This is a gentle book. Planned content includes:

• A parent’s grief and resentment over a mother who died giving birth

• Emergency-department scenes during medical training

• Hacking and online threats (at story level)
